notes.title: The less clothes, the stronger! Story Of Eve 2 continues the journey of the young heroine!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/872c09feb68253ef6eb7b7cc3552f16d7a5c8e65.gif[/img]

[h2] About Game [/h2]

After [i]Story of Eve - A Hero's Study[/i], the succubus Kassandra persuades you to train Eve using some "unorthodox" methods. Eve, marked with lewd runes, makes a diligent effort to become stronger. However, as the training progresses, Eve seems to start... enjoying the process. How will your special training methods affect Eve? Who knows...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/f2da870e0f0744a437d0bcde1244ef44da33a797.jpg[/img]

[h2] Game Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] The same exploration system as the original, but with enhanced maze-like features.
[*] Born from the rock, paper, scissors system, the brand-new card battles bring buckets of action-packed fun to Eve 2!
[*] Complete special missions to make Eve's clothes more sexy and increase her battle power!
[*] Your special training will turn the docile Eve into a domineering powerhouse... She might even counterattack you, so watch out!

[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/b0fbba6fed8f0e494efc677df7ac55aa1fb345be.jpg[/img]

[h2] Add to Wishlist [/h2]

[i]Story Of Eve 2[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959520

[i]Story Of Eve - A Hero's Study[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/928520

You may also like the following:
[hr][/hr]

[h2][i] X-Angels [/i][/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/64130c17bfa3372cbf5a405d59445b78b324410b.jpg[/img]

"X-Angels" is a rogue-lite card battle game. On the day you were supposed to lose your virginity, you were interrupted by a mysterious creature, who revealed that your purity is the key to defeating the corrupt Angels!

[h2]Add to Wishlist[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090810

[h2][i] Radiant Victorias [/i][/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/8f9c5bef0d4ae9c324827d343482fc57fdb8a411.png[/img]

With kindom Asira left in ruins, Wolf, the prince of Asira, embarks on a journey around the world where he teams up with eight heroines and tries to stop the empire's ambition.

Join us in this action RPG where you cultivate relationships with the heroines with unique stories!
